title: launches signal
description: Next 5 rocket launches from The Space Devs Launch Library 2 (free tier), refreshed every 3 h and cached across restarts. GET /api/signals/launches, polled every 30 min; 404 unless providers.launches.enabled (opt-in network); null until the first fetch. A launch that already happened can stay in the list until the next refresh. Not sensitive.

net.description: No-Earlier-Than time, ISO 8601 UTC, or null.

status.description: LL2 status abbreviation: Go, TBD, TBC, Success, Failure, Hold, In Flight, Partial Failure …

at.description: When it was fetched. Unix time in seconds (float).
